prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1130; do not mention it.)
text:
This office has been retained to represent the interests of our client in connection with injuries sustained in a rear-end collision involving your insured. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured, along with a written confirmation of any other coverage that may apply to this loss, including excess or umbrella policies.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes claim files, photographs, recorded statements, vehicle data, repair estimates, adjuster notes, and any electronic records or communications concerning the collision. Please take steps to ensure that this material is not altered, discarded, or destroyed while the claim is pending.

We look forward to your prompt written response. Until we hear from you, our client's position is fully reserved, and nothing in this letter should be construed as a waiver of any rights or claims.
